# Niam — DPDP Compliance Platform
> Niam scans codebases for personal data handling, maps data flows
> against India's DPDP Act 2023, and drafts compliance amendments.

## Pages
- /: Dashboard with compliance score and gap overview
- /gaps: Compliance gaps detected in scanned repositories
- /graph: Visual compliance graph showing data flows
- /repositories: Connected GitHub repositories
- /vendors: Third-party vendors detected in code
- /regulations: DPDP Act compliance status
- /policies: Privacy policy and legal document analysis
